tagline.en: NVIDIA's point-cloud world model — predicts how a 3D scene evolves, for robotics and embodied settings.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的点云世界模型——在 3D 场景中预测未来演化,面向机器人与具身场景。

en: PointWorld is a world model from NVIDIA (NVlabs) that operates directly in 3D point-cloud space. Rather than predicting pixels, it reasons about how a scene's geometry evolves, which suits robot and embodied tasks where 3D structure matters.

The model weights are published on Hugging Face under an Apache-2.0 license. In WorldFoundry the official source route is registered; you stage the PointWorld checkpoint and point-cloud assets, then run prediction through the pipeline.
zh: PointWorld 是 NVIDIA(NVlabs)推出的世界模型,直接在 3D 点云空间中工作。它不预测像素,而是推理场景几何如何随时间演化,适合看重 3D 结构的机器人与具身任务。
模型权重以 Apache-2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face 上。在 WorldFoundry 中已注册官方源路由;备好 PointWorld 的 checkpoint 与点云资源后,即可通过 pipeline 运行预测。

whenToUse.en: When you want to model or predict a 3D scene's dynamics in point-cloud space — for robot world modeling and embodied 3D tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在点云空间里建模或预测 3D 场景的动态时——用于机器人世界建模与具身 3D 任务。

notFor.en: Not a text-to-video or image generator. Running it requires downloading the checkpoint and point-cloud assets first.
notFor.zh: 它不是文生视频或图像生成器。运行前需先下载 checkpoint 与点云资源。

en: World modeling directly in 3D point-cloud space
Apache-2.0 licensed weights on Hugging Face
Built for robot and embodied 3D settings
zh: 直接在 3D 点云空间进行世界建模
Hugging Face 上以 Apache-2.0 许可发布权重
